BLOG.TITLE: Development Log
BLOG.SUBTITLE: Technical documentation of challenges faced and solutions implemented in my projects.

HOMES.NAME: Angular Homes App
HOMES.CHALLENGE: Managing real-time search filters without slowing down the user interface.
HOMES.SOLUTION: Implementing filter functions based on TypeScript and native input events, optimizing the SPA.

PORTFOLIO.NAME: Personal Portfolio (This Site)
PORTFOLIO.CHALLENGE: Synchronizing visual style across different routes eliminating sharp color breaks.
PORTFOLIO.SOLUTION: Developing a continuous gradient layout and centralizing CSS with Bento Grid design.

CHECKLIST.NAME: Travel Packing Checklist
CHECKLIST.CHALLENGE: Managing the state of checked items and persisting the list data so it doesn't clear out upon reloading the page.
CHECKLIST.SOLUTION: Utilizing JavaScript functions for dynamic DOM manipulation and saving persistent data using localStorage.

HPQUIZ.NAME: Harry Potter Quiz
HPQUIZ.CHALLENGE: Creating an interactive score system with sequential question progression without reloading the page.
HPQUIZ.SOLUTION: Developing the game logic in vanilla JavaScript using arrays of objects, conditional flow handling, and dynamic UI rendering.

GAMEBOOK.NAME: gamebook-engine
GAMEBOOK.CHALLENGE: Develop a flexible logical architecture capable of parsing complex branching narratives without affecting rendering performance.
GAMEBOOK.SOLUTION: Utilized TypeScript for strict typing of story nodes and centralized game state management using structured patterns.

MAISON.NAME: Maison-Ilaria
MAISON.CHALLENGE: Design an elegant and high-impact visual interface while ensuring smoothness and pixel-perfect layout precision.
MAISON.SOLUTION: Implemented advanced layouts with CSS Grid and Flexbox, optimizing smooth transitions and complete style customization.
